name: Chelaxian Trouper

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You are a renowned actor, dancer, opera singer, or other type of creative artist. As a result, you have frequently shared your talents with the Chelaxian elite and have won your fair share of admirers.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Theater Lore skill. You gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.
